message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a toddler Hocus Pocus costume. Costumes of textile materials are classified in 9505.90 as festive articles only if they are not wearing apparel under the Chapter 95 note. Note 1(e) to Chapter 95 excludes sports clothing and fancy dress of textiles in Chapters 61 or 62. Rulings on costumes made of ordinary textile fabric, as opposed to flimsy non-woven material, generally classify them as apparel.

The set consists of a dress, sash, cape and hat. As a set of toddler girls' apparel, it would likely go to 6208 or 6209 (babies' garments, sizes for children up to 24 months or 86 cm) or 6104/6204 for toddler sizes. A toddler size could be 2T-4T, which would be girls' dresses rather than babies' garments. The costume is probably knit polyester, which would put the dress in 6104.43 (girls' dresses, synthetic fibers, knit). The cape and hat are not classified as a set under GRI 3(b), so the essential character is the dress. Since this is a retail set, the dress gives the essential character and the whole set goes to 6104.43.2020 (girls' dresses, knit, synthetic fibers, other).

The statistical suffix for girls' dresses of synthetic fibers is 6104.43.2020 ("Girls'"). Under 6104.43.20, 2010 is for women's and 2020 is for girls'. I'll go with that.
